user_workflow: Choose source sections, stem levels and tempo; render actual audio; listen; approve the exact preview; inspect an empty Ableton destination; explicitly import.

supported: Shared pitch-preserving tempo adjustment from 80% to 125%
Aligned PCM24 WAV stems and preview
not_supported: Guaranteed artifact-free separation or time stretching
Local-only source upload without a separate explicit upload

safety: Source files are hashed before and after rendering; original audio and projects are not overwritten
Owner-scoped previews, source-use attestation and exact mix-hash approval
Empty Live Set identity checked before downloads and immediately before native placement
Stem byte counts and SHA-256 checked before placement
Interrupted or ambiguous imports are not replayed automatically
Old Bridges without approved-remix capability cannot execute this import
Private songs and recordings are excluded from code and installer publication
